planSteps.description: Replace the 'ballots-input' text with these 4 lines exactly: '4,Ann>_>Cy' then '5,[Ann=Ben]>Cy' then '6,Ben>Ann' then '3,Cy>Ann' (one per line) and click 'run-count'
Click the round tab 'dash-rail-r1' so round 1 is shown
The element data-testid 'eliminated' (below the round bars, not the transfer list) reads 'Eliminated after round 1: Cy'
Scroll the table data-testid 'rounds-table' (near the bottom of the page) into view
In 'rounds-table', the row data-testid 'table-inactive' has cells R1 '5' and R2 '5'
In 'rounds-table', the row with data-candidate='Ann' has cell-r1 '4' and cell-r2 '7', and the row with data-candidate='Ben' has cell-r1 '6' and cell-r2 '6'
